entries.reason: Google Meet join screen reflow: the 'Use Gemini to take notes' promo card animates in ~1s after load, appearing as a new clickable div and pushing the join controls down ~100pt. The animation lands between Flash's AX capture and Vimium's 'f' capture, so Vimium sees the post-reflow layout plus the late-appearing card while Flash captured the pre-reflow layout. Flash detects every control present at capture time; this card simply was not in the AX tree yet. Rect is page-relative (origin = fiducial pageScreenRect) so it is invariant to the offscreen window placement.

Same Google Meet reflow: 'Start' button at its post-reflow Y (488). Flash detected the identical button ~100pt away at its pre-reflow Y — see the matching flashOnly soft-warning — so this is a timing shift, not a missed target. Rect is page-relative (origin = fiducial pageScreenRect).

Same Google Meet reflow: 'Join now' button at its post-reflow Y (432). Flash detected the identical button ~100pt away at its pre-reflow Y — see the matching flashOnly soft-warning — so this is a timing shift, not a missed target. Rect is page-relative (origin = fiducial pageScreenRect).
